rtk-compressor-free 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Compress and export large video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) to smaller MP4s, optimized for quality and sharing.
- Zero-setup: simple upload and natural-language instructions, no manual sliders or advanced settings needed.
- Free built-in authentication with 100 credits (valid for 7 days) via anonymous token creation.
- Handles session management, cloud video processing, progress/status updates, and error handling automatically.
- Supports content creators, students, and marketers who need quick, high-quality compression with no extra software.
